name: tony7bones-repo
description: Script runner for the Tony.7.Bones Kodi add-on repository. The repo itself is static (GitHub Pages); these scripts wrap the Python release tooling. Each add-on's version lives only in its addons/<id>/addon.xml - intentionally NOT mirrored here, to avoid another place it could drift.

scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run check
